exampleEn: We need to think outside the box to solve this problem.
exampleKo: 이 문제를 해결하기 위해서는 틀을 벗어나서 생각해야 한다.
gameExamples: To innovate successfully, we must learn to think outside the box.
In order to attract more customers, the marketing team decided to think outside the box.
During the brainstorming session, everyone was encouraged to think outside the box and share their wild ideas.
